title: PostureRegressedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'posture.regressed'. STATE.md "Loombre Remote — embedded WireGuard + three-path wizard + reachability proof + posture card" (R7/RG4): RG4's adjudication — system_notices is HUMAN-composed only (one-active-slot), so a posture-check regression (cert expiring, connector down, a rate limiter silently disabled, ...) emits this admin-only event instead of auto-composing a notice; the posture card itself stays the persistent surface (S1 implements the real checkers server-side; packages/shared/src/remote/posture-model.ts is the pure grading/applicability module this event's shape mirrors). `checkKey` is the closed union from posture-model.ts's PostureCheckKey. Never carries any secret or config value — grades and a check identifier only. ADMIN-ONLY delivery, same posture as probe.failed/mail.failed.
